offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset (ms)
offset_ms.description: Shift lyric timing: positive values show lines earlier, negative later.

panel_size.label: Panel size
panel_size.description: Size preset of the lyrics panel: compact (440), medium (520), large (640). The bar widget and control-center tile open this preset.

use_cache.label: Cache lyrics
use_cache.description: Store fetched lyrics in the plugin data directory for offline reuse.

local_lyrics_dir.label: Local lyrics folder
local_lyrics_dir.description: Folder with local .lrc files named 'Artist - Title.lrc'; searched before LRCLIB.
